ModMetaData.name: Test Harness — FindMod Bridge
ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description: The UNCHANGED "bridge" mod for the PatchOperationFindMod live fixture (issue #40). Reproduces the real-world shape (oppey.eyegenes2's patch gated on nals.facialanimation's DISPLAY NAME): this mod's patch tests whether joof.testharness.gate is ACTIVE — by mod NAME, not packageId, exactly like PatchOperationFindMod's real ApplyWorker (ModLister.HasActiveModWithName) — and, only when it is, strips a tag from its own TC_FM_Host def via a PatchOperationSequence wrapped in the FindMod's <match> branch. This mod, its Defs, and its Patch file are BYTE IDENTICAL between Run A and Run B; the gate mod (joof.testharness.gate) is what flips between runs. Any divergence in TC_FM_Host's resolved content is therefore driven ENTIRELY by the FindMod branch evaluation reacting to the mod-list change — the same shape as the real #40 bug, where removing nals.facialanimation silently changed oppey.eyegenes2's resolved defs with neither mod's own files changing. Reuses joof.testharness.gate (the existing P4 fixture's toggle mod) as its gate, rather than adding a second throwaway "presence" mod, since the two fixtures need the exact same on/off toggle shape. No game content — dev/QA use only.
